description: The actions an organization's guardrail check may take, for each check type the console offers (GuardrailConfigTab's GUARDRAIL_CHECKS and MODEL_GUARDRAIL_CHECKS, by the names the gateway receives; a section stored as rules names pii-detection pii-detector). Every check takes actions. A check type listed in mask can also take mask: its guardrail can rewrite the request it reads (guardrails.Masker in the gateway), and the gateway runs such a check as a mask of the request, which then goes on, as in log mode (release note C34). Two tests read this file, so the console cannot drift from the gateway unnoticed: the gateway's (agentcc-gateway/internal/guardrails/check_actions_contract_test.go) builds each check type as the gateway builds an organization's check, from its name and, for a model check, its provider, and checks that it can mask exactly when it is listed in mask; the console's (frontend/src/sections/gateway/guardrails/checkActions.test.jsx) checks that its catalog names exactly these checks with these providers, and that both guardrail dialogs offer exactly these actions for each.
